message.instantriptide.missing_bucket: No water bucket in the hotbar
message.instantriptide.no_elytra: No elytra found on the player
config.instantriptide.title: Instant Riptide
config.instantriptide.mode.tooltip: Instant pours the water and launches on the same tick. Legit plays out a slower, player-like sequence of hotbar switches and camera moves
config.instantriptide.water_refill.toolt: Picks the poured water back into an empty bucket right after the riptide launch
config.instantriptide.use_elytra.tooltip: After a ground-riptide launch, automatically opens the elytra the instant you leave the ground. Requires an elytra to be worn in the chest slot
